interactables.name: Officer Reyes
interactables.text: [Officer Reyes] guards the door with the weary dignity of a man who trained for hostage negotiations and got missing poultry instead. He clocks you immediately. 'Don't start, cat.'

topics.text: He looks down. You sit straighter. Something in him approves. 'Lockdown since [8:15 PM]. Full perimeter, my seal on every door. Nobody in, nobody out.' A pause. 'You were already inside. Don't make it weird.'

topics.prompt: Meow at the sealed front door
topics.text: 'Door stays shut.' He crouches, scratches your ear once, and stands back up like it never happened. 'Think it through, whiskers. [Gate locked, doors sealed]. If that bird left the property, it left before my lockdown - or it never left at all.'

topics.prompt: Nudge the guest registry toward him
topics.text: 'The book? Everyone signs it. The crew called it old-fashioned. I call it evidence.' He taps the page without reading it. 'More than one of these arrival times smells off to me. People drift in [half an hour before] anyone expects them, sign sloppy, blame traffic.'|He straightens back to his post. 'Somebody's evening in this book does not add up. Whose? That's your department, whiskers.'

interactables.name: Chip Sterling
interactables.altText: [Chip Sterling] has stopped pacing. The phone hangs dark at his side while he watches you work the room. 'Still on the case? Good. Whatever you are doing, do it faster - find that bird before the morning shows do.'
interactables.text: The Manager, [Chip Sterling], paces a groove into the rug, phone welded to his ear. 'No comment. NO comment. Fine, one comment: my client LOVES animals.' He hangs up and stares at nothing. You memorize his face.|He points the dead phone at you. 'One rule, cat. Nobody repeats what that bird says. Rudebeak has opinions about everyone in this house, and none of them are printable.'

topics.prompt: Rub against his very expensive trousers
topics.text: 'Off. OFF. This suit costs more than-' He stops. Deflates like a man remembering his week. 'A missing parrot. Front page news. Do you know what this does to her brand? It's a [PR Disaster]. I have three interviews to cancel and a bird to un-lose.'

topics.prompt: Swat the phone out of his hand mid-pace
topics.text: He catches it one-handed without looking. A man with practice. 'That bird is not just a bird. Rudebeak has a documentary deal, and I take [fifteen percent] of everything my clients earn. Feathers included.'|'Is he charming? No. He heckled a talk show host until the man cried. But rude SELLS, cat.' He hears himself. 'Which is exactly why I would never LOSE him.'

topics.prompt: Stare at the sealed door with him
topics.text: 'Yeah. Locked in with a crime scene and a film crew. My publicist says stay visible, look concerned.' He practices a concerned face in the hall mirror. It needs work.|'Want my theory? Whoever did this is [still in the house]. Nobody has left since eight-fifteen.'

interactables.name: The Officer's Radio
interactables.text:
The Officer's radio crackles on the sideboard. You put one ear toward it, professionally.
Dispatch: 'All units, confirm north gate status.'
Reyes: 'North gate locked [all evening]. Over.'
Dispatch: 'Copy that. Perimeter sealed since [8:15 PM]. Nothing in or out through the garden. Hold your post, Reyes.'

interactables.name: Guest Registry
interactables.text:
A formal sign-in book by the entrance. [The whole household] parades through it:
- Wexler, director - 4:15 PM
- Petra, bird handler (plus one macaw) - 5:05 PM
- Coco, socialite - 5:50 PM
- Staff, signed in since morning|The film crew's column begins at [6:30 PM]. The signatures blur together - hurried, overlapping, hard to count.

localDeductionSentence: The [Lockdown] sealed the mansion tight - Chip only fears a [PR Disaster], and the sign-in book logs the [Crew Arrivals] from 6:30 PM on.
